rows.en: What is that boy doing...?
That boy... Is he actually talking to a Mulian...!?
rows.notes: Thought and speaker placeholder preserved.

rows.en: Just what are you...!?
uncertain: Genuinely unfinished identification question What are you... retained.

rows.en: I must go on living... in an eternal cycle of reincarnation... to repeat the ritual of death and rebirth.
rows.notes: Life and eternal reincarnation/death-rebirth ritual retained.

rows.en: And... to have you choose among the paths to the future.
rows.notes: Purpose clause continues555; future choices belong to listeners.
uncertain: Genuine row-boundary purpose continuation of555, not an independent sentence.

rows.en: Yes... I am the very trial that beings called gods set before humanity.
Are you a Tuner too...? No, are you something close to that!?
If they do not meet me, neither the tuning of the world nor Instrumentality will take place. ...This is a rite of passage.
rows.notes: They are Shinji and allies; without meeting Kaworu, neither tuning nor Instrumentality happens.

rows.en: Now... won't you stop tormenting them?
rows.notes: Kaworu asks Mamoru to stop hurting Shinji and his friends; request direction preserved.

rows.en: Shinji and his friends have delicate hearts. ...Just like you.
Mamoruuuu!!
Ayato... Before long, you won't be able to remain human. The time will come when you abandon your humanity.

rows.en: I'll be there to see you do it...! I'll see it through...!!
rows.notes: Mamoru will witness Ayato abandoning humanity, not protect him.

...As of now... this operation is over...! Shift to Level 1 alert...!
rows.notes: Level1 alert differs from battle stations.

...What about Unit-00?
The entry plug's ejection... has not been confirmed.
rows.notes: Entry-plug ejection unconfirmed, not proven failed.

...If there are any, that is.
rows.notes: Ritsuko questions whether survivors exist; no death confirmation.
Wordless shock retained before incoming report.

Yes.
Was that man the one who let him out...?
rows.notes: That man unnamed; no invented identity.

uncertain: Source appends a suspended description of the song.

...So that boy has appeared, just as I thought...

rows.en: Then it's finally beginning... The overture to the final movement...
rows.notes: Musical final-movement metaphor preserved.
uncertain: Source appends a suspended identification of the overture.

Even if Bahbem devises another plan, we have a way to counter it... #部隊名 and Medius Locus.

rows.en: Though Zapat's death did cause a slight upset.
rows.notes: Main/campaign short surname Zapat; minor upset, not unpredicted surprise.

rows.notes: Death within expected range; that woman remains unnamed.

rows.en: Besides... Once that devil disappears, Medius and they will have served their purpose.
rows.notes: Source-short Medius and they remain short; committee considers them disposable.

rows.en: ...And only one Angel described in SEELE's Dead Sea Scrolls remains...
uncertain: Source leaves its final remaining-Angel phrase suspended.

rows.en: The promised time is near. The road has been long, and the sacrifices have been great.
Indeed... The loss of Unit-00 is more than enough reason to dismiss Ikari.
We'll need a human sacrifice... to use against Ikari.
rows.notes: Human sacrifice preserves the human-pillar sacrificial metaphor, with no invented physical ritual.

rows.en: And we need someone who knows the facts...
Misato! Rei... How is Rei!?
Wh-why won't you answer!? She was fine last time thanks to her AT Field, wasn't she!?
...I don't know either. The technical department is recovering Unit-00's wreckage in strict secrecy.
rows.notes: Wreckage recovery kept separate from knowledge of Rei status.

rows.en: In strict secrecy...?
uncertain: Source trails off an incredulous echo of in strict secrecy.

rows.en: ...Misato... Aren't you hiding something from us?
I want to know what Ritsuko and the others are doing too...
Shinji...
...Misato... My tears won't come.
rows.notes: Tears do not come despite sadness.

rows.en: Even though I feel sad, my tears just won't come...
...U-um... How is Asuka...?
rows.notes: Grammatically complete contextual question; no invented result.

rows.en: ...She's been taken to the hospital. Her life isn't in danger, but she still hasn't regained consciousness.
rows.notes: Asuka alive, hospitalized and still unconscious.

rows.en: D-dammit...!! If we... If we'd done our job right, this wouldn't have...!!
uncertain: Source leaves the consequence of the allies acting correctly unfinished.

Don't blame yourself, Misato...
...And what about Ayato?
...Right now, my sister is...
rows.notes: Megumi addresses the group; her sister is Haruka, but source sister preserved.
uncertain: Megumi breaks off the clause about her sister; next row completes the information.

...Ayato...
...I can't paint...
rows.notes: Painting inability; delayed object is in611.
uncertain: Source sentence spans610/611 with delayed painting object; preserve row boundary.

...the picture I wanted you to see.
rows.notes: Painting is the one Ayato wanted Haruka to see.

rows.notes: Source-short surname Asahina kept; not expanded to Hiroko.
uncertain: Source appends a suspended list of the people Haruka knew about.

rows.notes: Haruka withholds Mamoru detail, unfinished source clause preserved.
uncertain: Haruka breaks off what she knows about Mamoru.

rows.en: Mom... and Mamoru both lied to me. What for...? What were they trying to make me do...?
rows.notes: Mother and Mamoru both lied; purpose unknown.

rows.en: ...I... What am I, really...?
...Ayato...
...Rei Ayanami...
She is the product of my despair, and even now, the vessel for your hope...
rows.notes: Fuyutsuki MY despair, Gendo YOUR hope; both possessives kept.

rows.en: I suppose it's impossible to forget, after all...
...Ikari... Will your son become our Ollin?
rows.notes: Our Ollin is posed as a question, not identification.

rows.en: We don't know yet.
Perhaps... only EVA-01 knows.
rows.notes: Explicit EVA-01 name preserved, only possessor of knowledge hypothetical.

rows.en: ...How did it go?
For now, we've been told to maintain the status quo... We'll continue our guard duty here...
rows.notes: Orders remain status quo and continuing local guard duty.
uncertain: Masato leaves his continued guard-duty assignment trailing off.

rows.en: ...It's as good as losing three EVAs. If we were attacked here now, we wouldn't stand a chance.
More to the point, that boy. The fifth Evangelion pilot... What is he?
That Dolem seemed to be talking to him about something...
And... instead of finishing us and Ayato off, it withdrew...
rows.notes: Dolem withdrew without killing the group or Ayato; not boy withdrawing.
uncertain: Source leaves the withdrawal noun/verb phrase trailing; English restores grammar but retains trailing delivery.

rows.en: Could he possibly be a Mulian too?
I don't think so. He... There's something about him...
rows.notes: The boy is the uncertain referent; no invented identity answer.
uncertain: Masato twice breaks off his description of the boy.

rows.en: He reminds me of myself... A child brought into this world by someone's design...
rows.notes: Smell is likeness/intuitive recognition metaphor; designed birth does not add cloning mechanism.
uncertain: Source leaves the designed-child description suspended.

rows.en: If my guess is right... he...
uncertain: Masato leaves the conditional inference about him unfinished.

rows.en: #男愛称! Everyone!
What's wrong, #女愛称?
R-Rei...! Rei's all right!!
rows.notes: Rei safety reported now, not back-projected into unconfirmed ejection.
Pure shock punctuation retained.

rows.en: ...I... Why am I here?
I... Why am I alive again?
rows.notes: Alive again stays Rei own question; no claim that same prior Rei revived.

rows.en: For what... for whom...?
rows.notes: Purpose fragments follow her renewed survival, not a new full question with invented object.
uncertain: Genuine continuation of638/639: purpose/beneficiary fragments follow why am I alive; retained.

rows.en: Ayanami!!

rows.en: I'm glad... you're safe, Ayanami...
...Um... Dad hasn't come to see you?
...Thank you... for saving us.
What are you thanking me for?
rows.notes: Rei asks what Shinji fears; verb restored. Stage49-only context correction independently reviewed by worker6 and root: Rei responds to Shinji thanking her for rescue, not his earlier fear. The complete question restores the contextual subject and predicate. Stage08 owner remains unchanged.

rows.notes: Replies to reusedFULL826 contextual override What are you thanking me for; no fear reading.

...You don't remember?
No... I don't know about it.
rows.notes: Unknown event, not forgotten memory.

rows.en: Because... I think I'm probably the third one.
rows.notes: Third person/incarnation, not Third Child pilot; no explicit reincarnation mechanism added.

rows.en: ...The third one...!?
Go.
What...!?
rows.notes: Shinji's startled reaction.

rows.en: Go. You don't need to worry about me.
Y-yeah...
rows.notes: Context: Earth pre-battle conversation; speaker and listener follow numeric-use neighbors. Subject/action restored where English requires them.

rows.en: ...You're the First Child, aren't you?
rows.notes: Full First Child source designation.

rows.en: Rei Ayanami... You're the same as me. The bodies we live in on this planet have both ended up taking the same form as the Lilin...
...Who are you?
That's right. Maintain the First Child's current status...
rows.notes: Clarify operational direction for status quo; avoid implying physical/incarnation preservation. No fit compression.

rows.en: The Second, Third, Fourth... and Fifth need only be monitored. Begin Unit-02's sync test.
rows.notes: Source-short Second/Third/Fourth/Fifth kept short.

rows.en: Has the Fifth boy made contact with Rei?
MAGI is checking the Fifth's data with every resource it has... He is probably...
rows.notes: Identification predicate unspoken.
uncertain: Genuinely unfinished identification predicate: He is probably...

rows.en: Besides, if Rei is alive, Chairman Keel and the others won't be happy, will they?
I've offered the old men of SEELE something else... There's no need to worry.
rows.notes: Something else unexpanded here; later allegation names Ritsuko.

rows.en: ...In any case, MU and the Fifth are unwelcome visitors to us...
And they are the accursed keys that open the door to the end and the beginning.
We would like this to proceed peacefully, too. We don't want you to suffer any more...
I don't feel anything, though.
She's a strong-willed woman... I can see why Ikari wants to keep her close.
But the one who handed you over to us was none other than... Ikari himself.
rows.notes: Committee allegation; not omniscient fact.
Wordless shocked response retained.

rows.en: He refused to let us interrogate Unit-00's pilot... He sent you as her substitute, Dr. Akagi.
rows.notes: Keel alleges Ikari offered Ritsuko instead of interrogating Rei.

rows.en: Me... in Rei's place...?
uncertain: Genuinely broken realization Me... in Rei place; no completed source predicate.

rows.en: Then... let us begin the inquiry.
...Try lowering it another 0.3.
rows.notes: 0.3 parameter unspecified; no percent or unit.

There's no mistake in this data, is there?
All measurement systems are operating normally.
MAGI has detected no errors in the data.
I never imagined he could sync with Unit-02 without even converting its core...
rows.notes: Without core conversion preserved.

rows.en: But I can't believe it. No... it's impossible within the system.
rows.notes: System impossibility, not simple disbelief.

rows.en: This fact... to Dr. Akagi, immediately...

uncertain: Genuinely interrupted report proposal: original ends at Dr. Akagi recipient before reporting predicate;677 stops it. English source-shaped fragments deliberately retain withheld predicate.

rows.en: She is away on another matter right now. The report can wait.
Y-yes...
What should we do?
First accept the facts, then try to find the cause.
Yes...
Still, that's amazing. This was your first time in an EVA, right?
That's right.
And yet, you managed a sync rate like that...
uncertain: Source trails off in amazement at the sync rate; no further evaluation supplied.

rows.en: You're amazing, Kaworu...
You sure are. Maybe Soryu can focus on her treatment now.
rows.notes: Source surname Soryu retained.

rows.en: Heh... But I'm no match for you all.
Th-that's not true. Even I didn't know what was going on when I first got into an EVA...
...What are you going to do now, Shinji?
I-I'm going back to my room, but...
uncertain: Genuinely unfinished contrast after but; no following proposition supplied.

rows.en: May I go with you?
Huh...? W-why do you want to?
Because I'm interested in you.
I-interested...?
uncertain: Source repeats interested with unfinished questioning quotation; retained.

rows.en: What's this, Sensei...? Something's fishy, huh?
rows.notes: Toji fixed Shinji nickname Sensei kept; ordinary honorific rule does not apply.
uncertain: Sensei is Toji fixed Shinji nickname, source-scoped with SRWwiki corroboration; no exact Akurasu nickname or licensed MX English nickname wording verified.

rows.en: W-what are you talking about, Toji?
Anyway, it looks like we're in the way. Come on, let's go, Ayanami.
Ah... Toji... Ayanami...
...You go to extremes to avoid even brief contact. Are you afraid of connecting with people...?
rows.notes: Brief interpersonal contact; no sexual implication or invented physical avoidance.

rows.en: ...I used to be... But now...
rows.notes: Former fear versus now unresolved.
uncertain: Genuinely unfinished contrast after now; no claim about current fear supplied.

rows.en: If you don't know other people, you can't be betrayed. You can't hurt each other either...
But you've overcome pain and sadness, haven't you? As part of #部隊名.
Y... Yeah...
But people can never rid themselves of loneliness forever... Each person is alone.
Still, people can go on living... because they can forget.
rows.notes: Forgetting enables continued life, causality retained.

rows.en: Memories of the former world... the trials there... the pain... the sadness... forgetting all of it...
rows.notes: Former world/trials/pain/sadness entire list preserved.
uncertain: Genuine row-boundary metaphysical list and forgetting fragment; no new predicate supplied.

rows.en: W-what do you mean?
People always feel pain in their hearts. The heart is sensitive to pain... so they find living painful too.
But that is necessary to stop the world from falling apart.
rows.notes: That refers to painful struggle just discussed; no new mechanism.

rows.en: The world falling apart...?
uncertain: Source repeats falling-apart world phrase as trailing question; no explanatory predicate supplied.

rows.en: ...It was painful, wasn't it, Shinji? The battle to stop that...
uncertain: Trailing explanatory noun phrase the battle... kept after complete contextual question.

rows.en: K-Kaworu...
You're as delicate as glass... your heart, especially...
Am I that delicate...?
rows.notes: Contextually restores delicate predicate to ordinary pro-drop response.

rows.en: Yes. You're worthy of affection.
rows.notes: Affection expressly retained.

rows.en: Affection...
uncertain: Source repeats affection as a wondering fragment; retained.

rows.notes: Like expresses warm affection without adding stronger love declaration.

rows.notes: Born to meet Shinji; do not add destiny.

rows.en: Th-that's...

uncertain: Genuinely unfinished reply Th-that...; no invented denial or completion.

Huh? But...
uncertain: Shinji leaves his objection after but unfinished.

Y-yeah... Well, then...
uncertain: Shinji leaves his farewell after well then trailing.

But, Shinji... you have to accept it.
rows.notes: Private thought directed conceptually at Shinji; source stray thought close ignored.

rows.en: Just like that Ollin...
rows.notes: Separate row comparison to that Ollin kept, not expanded identity.
uncertain: Source comparison is a separate suspended row, not merged into727.

rows.notes: Akagi treatment/send-back decision, not a medical procedure assumed.

She's done much for the EVA Series... We might as well get a little more use out of her.
uncertain: Source opens with a suspended identification of her as EVA contributor.

rows.en: Indeed... For the future of humanity. To overcome the world's collapse.
uncertain: Purpose clauses refer to previous row; suspended source-purpose phrasing retained.

rows.notes: Committee says eight EVAs being prepared; do not import other totals.

rows.en: That leaves four more...
rows.notes: Four more remain; source claim preserved.

rows.en: Have them hurry to complete the EVA Series. That day will be the promised time.
Well? Did you get the data on the Fifth boy?
Here it is. I borrowed it from First Lieutenant Ibuki without her permission.
rows.notes: NERV Maya Ibuki rank rendered First Lieutenant Ibuki from sourced profile.

rows.en: Sorry. I keep making you do things like a thief.
Don't worry about it. I want to know the truth too.
What is this...!?
...No wonder Maya can't make this public. It's theoretically impossible.
rows.notes: Maya is Ibuki; theoretical impossibility is Makoto explanation.

rows.en: Yes... The mystery just keeps deepening...
He can set his synchronization rate with the EVA however he likes... And by his own will, at that.
rows.notes: Synchronization rate can be set freely by will; no invented mechanism.
Wordless shocked response retained.

rows.en: What's wrong?
...Nothing. We'll talk about this another time.
Y-yes...
...Ritsuko... So you've come back...
! The passcode...?
uncertain: Ritsuko breaks off what is wrong with the passcode.

...I'm going to see this place's secrets with my own eyes.
All right. But this boy comes with us too.
rows.notes: Boy is Shinji; source this boy retained.

rows.en: Misato...
...All right.
These are... EVAs...!?
The first ones. But they were failures. They were discarded ten years ago.
rows.notes: Initial failed EVAs discarded ten years ago, separate from fifteen-year event.

rows.en: ...So many...! It's like... an EVA graveyard...
It's just a garbage dump. ...And it's also where your mother disappeared.
rows.notes: Mother disappeared here; no invented death mechanism.

rows.notes: Shinji witnessed disappearance; recall is uncertain, witnessing is stated.

...Let's go. There's more further in.
...This is...

Th-this is...!?
rows.notes: Source startled incomplete identification retained.

rows.en: Ayanami... Rei...!
Don't tell me the EVA's Dummy Plug is...!?
uncertain: Misato leaves the Dummy Plug identification unfinished.

rows.notes: Factory produces cores for Dummy System, not factory being a core.

rows.en: This is...!?
uncertain: Misato breaks off shocked identification after this is.

rows.notes: Dummies and Rei spare parts, not souls.

rows.en: Humans found a god and eagerly tried to claim it... So they were punished.
rows.notes: God found/claimed then punishment; retain explanation as Ritsuko speech.

rows.en: That was fifteen years ago...
rows.notes: Fifteen years before present, distinct from failed EVAs discarded ten years ago.

rows.en: Second Impact...!
The god they'd finally found disappeared because of it...
But this time, they tried to revive a god themselves. That was... Adam.
And from Adam, they created humans in a god's image... Those are the EVAs.
rows.notes: Humans created from Adam in a god image; source explicitly names EVAs.

rows.en: Humans...? Evangelions are human!?
rows.notes: Shinji questions EVA human status.

rows.en: Yes... They're human. EVAs originally have no souls, so human souls have been placed within them.
rows.notes: EVAs originally soulless, human souls lodged inside; no cloning mechanism.

rows.en: They were all... salvaged from a different world.
rows.notes: They retains source everyone/all antecedent, probably souls in778; no claim EVAs manufactured elsewhere.
uncertain: Source all/they antecedent unresolved: nearest is human souls, but EVA referent and Misato next question permit broader scope. Kept pronoun rather than assert manufacture elsewhere.

rows.en: Then, like the MU... are EVAs and Angels from another world...!?
rows.notes: Misato asks origin inference; not narrated certainty.
uncertain: Source origin question trails off; question grammar restored, not asserted as fact.

rows.en: But Rei is the only vessel that contains a soul. A soul was born only in her.
rows.notes: Only Rei vessel has soul; born in her, not merely externally inserted.

rows.en: The Chamber of Guf had become empty.
rows.notes: Chamber of Guf binding campaign term, not Guf door.

rows.en: These things lined up here that look like Rei have no souls. They're just vessels. Dolls, like Dolems.
rows.notes: These Rei-like copies are soulless vessels compared to Dolems; no broader all-Dolems assertion.

rows.en: ...That's why I'll destroy them. Because I hate them.
rows.notes: Destruction motivated by hatred; no softened reason.

rows.en: You! Do you know what you're doing!?
Yes... I know. Destruction. They aren't human. They're things shaped like humans.
But I lost even to a thing like that...! I couldn't win...!
rows.notes: Lost to that thing emotionally; no added Gendo affection explanation.

rows.en: Just thinking of him let me endure any... any violation and degradation...!
rows.notes: Harsh violation and degradation retained without invented specific acts.

rows.en: I don't care what happens to my body...!
rows.notes: Disregard for own body retained.

rows.en: But... But he... He...!
rows.notes: Him remains unnamed; genuine predicate interruption retained.
uncertain: Ritsuko twice breaks off the predicate about him.

rows.en: I knew...! I'm a fool...! Mother and daughter, we're both complete fools...!
rows.notes: Mother and daughter both complete fools; no father included.

rows.en: Ritsuko...
If you want to kill me, do it. No... I'd be happy if you did...
rows.notes: Direct request/happiness at being killed retained unsmoothed.

rows.en: ...That really does make you a fool... You...
uncertain: Misato ends with a repeated you fragment; source rebuke complete before it.

rows.en: ...Ugh... Uhhh... Uhhh...
...The tragedy of people possessed by EVA...
uncertain: Misato thought is a suspended nominal tragedy description.

rows.en: Am I... the same?
rows.notes: Misato questions whether she shares EVA obsession; not narrator assertion.

rows.en: ...Rei Ayanami... That feeling, after all... Mom...?
uncertain: Shinji leaves feeling recognition and mother identification open.

rows.en: Dad... Dad, to Mom and Ayanami... What... What are you doing...!?
rows.notes: Father clause unfinished, no invented action against mother or Rei.
uncertain: Shinji leaves father/actions/object clause unfinished before restarting as a question.

rows.en: I... What should I do...? How can I face Ayanami...?
rows.notes: Thought follows discovery of Rei copies/mother memory; face Ayanami emotional response.

rows.en: Tell me... Mom... Asuka... Kaworu...!
What should I do...!?
Humans cannot create anything from nothing. They cannot do anything without clinging to something. Humans are not gods, after all.
rows.notes: Humans dependence/nondivinity claim, full three propositions.

rows.en: But there are men who are trying to obtain power equal to a god's.
There are others besides us who are trying to open Pandora's box again...
Those are the blue-blooded people... and Ernst von Bahbem.
rows.notes: Full Ernst von Bahbem source name retained.

rows.en: There is a man who is trying to close the box before the hope within it appears.
Hope...? Is that the Lilin's hope?
There are as many forms of hope as there are people...
Because hope exists only within people's hearts.
But our hope has taken concrete form...
That is Lilith, the progenitor of our humanity... the false heirs from the Black Moon.
rows.notes: SEELE claim: humanity false heirs from Black Moon, Lilith progenitor. Not narrative fact. Lilith exact name now verified from registered Akurasu name-only term; no plot import.

rows.en: And that is Adam, the progenitor of the Angels... the rightful heirs from the lost White Moon.
rows.notes: SEELE claim: Angels rightful heirs from lost White Moon, Adam progenitor. Not narrative fact.

rows.en: That salvaged soul exists only within you.
rows.notes: Salvaged soul only within Kaworu; not body.

rows.en: But... Adam's regenerated body is already inside Ikari.
rows.notes: Regenerated body already inside Ikari; not soul.

rows.en: Shinji's father... Is he the same as me too?
That is why we entrust our wish... to you.
Before the false heirs... the blue-blooded people... the mechanical god and its Instrumentalist produce the sound of tuning...
rows.notes: Full false-heirs/blue-blooded/mechanical-god/Instrumentalist references and sound-quality metaphor retained.
uncertain: Genuine unfinished before-clause, continued through819-821 purpose fragments; no finite main action added.

uncertain: Genuine purpose fragment with Human->Multiverse correction; unfinished main clause retained.

uncertain: Genuine nonfinite action conjunction uniting all worlds/inhabitants; continues toward purpose821 without a completed independent main clause.

rows.en: To escape the cycle of death and rebirth, and obtain a new future...
rows.notes: Death/rebirth cycle and new future kept.
uncertain: Genuine purpose continuation: escaping cycle and obtaining future; no added finite main clause.

rows.en: I understand. That is why I am here now, after all...
Everything follows the flow of the Lilin... The decision is entrusted to Shinji and the others... apart from your intentions.
rows.notes: Shinji and others decide apart from SEELE intentions; no asserted obedience.

rows.en: Hello... Have you come to stop me, Ixtli?

rows.notes: Deduplicated silence appears at ten uses; remains neutral silence.

rows.en: I don't intend to interfere with your sound... He doesn't wish for that either.
rows.notes: Sound quality, not pitches/melody; he unnamed.
uncertain: He referent remains unspecified in this row; no identity added.

rows.en: ...What will you choose?
That... depends on your Ollin and our Ollin.
rows.notes: Your Ollin and our Ollin without imported names.

rows.en: But the 'spear' that will grant your wishes...
rows.notes: Source-short spear; no Longinus name expansion.
uncertain: Genuinely unfinished spear question/proposition; predicate unspoken.

rows.en: That isn't needed. We don't need a spear to pierce a god's heart. Of course... that goes for your god too.
rows.notes: Unnecessary heart-piercing spear extends to their god.

rows.en: Therefore... the one offered to a god cannot be stopped.
rows.notes: Identity of god-offered one intentionally not supplied.
uncertain: The one offered to a god has unresolved identity; passive preserves it without imported lore.
Actor of inability to stop the god-offered one is left passive because source does not name one; source identity is also unresolved.

rows.en: And... you cannot stop me either.
Yes... I am not the one who decides the path all worlds will follow, Ixtli...
Now, let's go. Adam's other self... and the servant of the Lilin.
rows.notes: Addressed Unit-02 as Adam counterpart/Lilin servant, no pilot added.

rows.en: EVA Unit-02 is activating!!
rows.notes: Unit-02 activation report, not launch.

rows.en: That's impossible! Where is Asuka!?
She's in hospital room 303! We've confirmed it!!
rows.notes: Hospital room303 exact.

rows.en: Then who is doing this!?
It's unmanned! No Entry Plug has been inserted into Unit-02!!
rows.notes: Unmanned and no inserted Entry Plug, no hidden pilot conjecture.

rows.en: There's no one inside...!? Isn't it the Fifth boy!?
An AT Field has been confirmed in Central Dogma!!
Is it Unit-02!?
No, Pattern Blue! There's no doubt, it's an Angel!!
What did you say?!
rows.notes: Misato demands clarification, also reused at the energy report.

rows.en: An Angel...! That boy is an Angel!?
The target is descending through Central Dogma! It has passed the fourth level!!
Emergency closure of all Central Dogma bulkheads. Buy us time, even a little.
rows.notes: All bulkheads; even slight time buying.

rows.en: The target has passed the fifth level!!
...So it really was that boy...!
The old men of SEELE intend to move the schedule forward even further. ...By our hands.
rows.notes: By our hands preserves Gendo own agency perspective.

rows.en: EVA Unit-02 is breaking through the armored bulkheads!!
The target has passed the second Cocytus!!
rows.notes: Source ordinal second Cocytus, no imported mechanics.
uncertain: Second Cocytus is source ordinal plus conventional name; exact licensed MX location wording unverified.

rows.en: Have EVA Unit-01 pursue it. Prepare all other units to launch immediately.
Yes...!
Stop the target from entering Terminal Dogma, by any means necessary.
But...! Why is the Angel using Unit-02...!?
rows.notes: Why Unit-02 question restored using from next fusion speculation.

rows.en: Could it be trying to merge with Unit-02?
Or perhaps it is using it to bring about destruction.
It's a lie! It's a lie! It's a lie! Kaworu is an Angel!? That's a lie!!
It's the truth... Accept it.
Launch immediately... understood?
You betrayed me...! You betrayed my feelings!! You betrayed me just like Dad did!!
Unit-01 has reached the lowest level! It will make contact with the target shortly!
Hyuga... If Unit-01's signal disappears, and there is another change after that...
rows.notes: Hyuga source surname; loss THEN another change; action withheld until863.
uncertain: Genuinely unfinished conditional; both Unit-01 signal loss and subsequent change retained before863 action.

rows.en: I understand. At that point, we self-destruct this place, right?
rows.notes: Self-destruct base at compound trigger, not mere signal loss.

rows.en: Yes.
It's better than allowing a Third Impact to happen.
I'm sorry.
It's all right. As long as I'm with you.
rows.notes: Affectionate with-you response; no relationship expansion.

rows.en: ...Thank you.
What!? What's going on!?
It's an AT Field more powerful than any we've seen before!!
It's blocking light waves, electromagnetic waves, and particles too! We can't monitor it!
rows.notes: Light waves/electromagnetic waves/particles all blocked.

rows.en: With this field, no unit other than Unit-01 can descend into Dogma!!
So it truly is a barrier...!
We've lost the signals from the target, EVA Unit-02, and Unit-01! We can't contact the pilots either!!
rows.notes: Clarify that loss means tracking signals/contact with all three targets, not destruction/death; all three and pilot contact kept. No fit compression.

rows.en: W-what's the situation!?
It's another AT Field!!
An AT Field equal in strength to the previous one has appeared near Terminal Dogma's barrier! It's neutralizing the barrier!!
rows.notes: Second equal-strength field near barrier neutralizes it.

rows.en: N-now the other units can descend too!!
Who's neutralizing the field!? Could it be another Angel!?
...Is it Rei?
rows.notes: Fuyutsuki inference/question retained.

rows.en: Th-the final safety lock has been released!!
rows.notes: Final safety lock, not a weapon safety invented.

rows.en: Heaven's Door... is opening...!!
rows.notes: Binding Heaven's Door spelling.

rows.en: The Angel... has finally made it here...!
...Hmph. That's enough entertainment.
rows.notes: Conditional original event separate from main hospitalized-Asuka sequence; no invented recovery.
uncertain: Conditional original event repeats Asuka mental attack despite main event later hospital status; event order/activation chronology unresolved. No recovery invented.

rows.en: Evangelion pilots... I'll destroy your minds.
rows.notes: Hidden speaker stays???; pilot minds targeted.
uncertain: Conditional original event repeats Asuka mental attack despite main event later hospital status; event order/activation chronology unresolved. No recovery invented.

rows.en: What the hell is that thing!?
rows.notes: Toji alarm with force retained.
uncertain: Conditional original event repeats Asuka mental attack despite main event later hospital status; event order/activation chronology unresolved. No recovery invented.

rows.en: That Dolem...!
uncertain: Miku breaks off identification at that Dolem.
Conditional original event repeats Asuka mental attack despite main event later hospital status; event order/activation chronology unresolved. No recovery invented.

rows.en: Is it the one that absorbed Unit-01 and RahXephon!?
rows.notes: Dolem absorbed both Unit-01 and RahXephon earlier.
uncertain: Conditional original event repeats Asuka mental attack despite main event later hospital status; event order/activation chronology unresolved. No recovery invented.

rows.en: Ugh! Aaaaaah!!
uncertain: Conditional original event repeats Asuka mental attack despite main event later hospital status; event order/activation chronology unresolved. No recovery invented.

rows.en: Asuka!?
uncertain: Conditional original event repeats Asuka mental attack despite main event later hospital status; event order/activation chronology unresolved. No recovery invented.

rows.en: Asuka's psychological graph is fluctuating! Mental contamination is beginning!
rows.notes: Source-literal psychological graph; no invented diagnostic method.
uncertain: Conditional original event repeats Asuka mental attack despite main event later hospital status; event order/activation chronology unresolved. No recovery invented.
Psychological graph is approved source-literal term; licensed MX wording unverified.

rows.en: I-it's the same... as that time...!
uncertain: Suspended comparison to previous time retained.
Conditional original event repeats Asuka mental attack despite main event later hospital status; event order/activation chronology unresolved. No recovery invented.

rows.en: If they lose the Evangelions, their plans will be set back...
rows.notes: Loss of EVAs sets back their plan, attacker subjective prediction.
uncertain: Conditional original event repeats Asuka mental attack despite main event later hospital status; event order/activation chronology unresolved. No recovery invented.

rows.en: And this world will be tuned, instead of undergoing Instrumentality.
rows.notes: Instrumentality/Tuning opposition retained as attacker claim.
uncertain: Conditional original event repeats Asuka mental attack despite main event later hospital status; event order/activation chronology unresolved. No recovery invented.

rows.en: All units, concentrate your attacks on that Dolem! Rescue Unit-02!!
rows.notes: Rescue Unit-02 from conditional attack, no chronology rewrite.
uncertain: Conditional original event repeats Asuka mental attack despite main event later hospital status; event order/activation chronology unresolved. No recovery invented.

rows.en: Understood! Everyone, we're going to save Asuka!!
uncertain: Conditional original event repeats Asuka mental attack despite main event later hospital status; event order/activation chronology unresolved. No recovery invented.

rows.en: Y-yes!!
uncertain: Conditional original event repeats Asuka mental attack despite main event later hospital status; event order/activation chronology unresolved. No recovery invented.

rows.en: You're late... Shinji.
Adam... The being who is our mother. Must those born of Adam return to Adam...? Even if it means destroying humanity?
rows.notes: Adam explicitly our mother, not father; humans destruction is questioned.
uncertain: Final even-if-humanity-destroyed clause remains an appended fragment.

rows.en: No...! This is... Lilith? I see... So that's how it is, Lilin.
rows.notes: Lilith recognition kept despite earlier Adam-body report; no lore correction.
uncertain: Source recognizes Lilith here although earlier report places Adam body inside Gendo; reveal/contradiction preserved without anime rewrite.

rows.en: I've been waiting for you, Shinji.
Kaworu!!
The EVA Series... Beings that are abhorrent to humans born of Adam...
uncertain: Source suspended EVA Series description retained.

rows.en: I can't understand the Lilin trying to survive even by using them.
Kaworu! Stop it! Why are you doing this!?
EVAs are made of the same body as mine. I was born of Adam too, after all.
rows.notes: EVA same body and Kaworu born of Adam; no inserted literal cloning detail.

rows.en: As long as there's no soul, I can assimilate it. The soul of this Unit-02 has now withdrawn into itself.
rows.notes: Absence of soul permits assimilation; Unit-02 soul has currently withdrawn itself, no named soul or permanent soulless claim.

rows.en: 1. EVA-01 is shot down
rows.notes: Plain defeat condition, exactly one source line.

rows.en: Shinji!!
A-Ayato...! And everyone else...!!
Heh... So she guided them here.
rows.notes: She likely Rei from adjacent original988, but source pronoun kept.
uncertain: She likely refers to Rei from original adjacent988; source does not name her, pronoun retained.

rows.en: Shinji, is he the last Angel...!?
Th-that's...!
uncertain: Shinji breaks off his response.

rows.en: That unit...
uncertain: Unit subject begins here; key predicate is in914.

rows.notes: Same exclamation serves i025b:66 after destiny question and i025b:73 after two Hakke robots report.

rows.en: ...has the key to the door of Guf.
rows.notes: Source-short door of Guf differs full Chamber of Guf door949.
uncertain: Predicate finishes statement begun in913 across source boundary.

rows.en: A key...!? Don't tell me you mean the Dimensional Coupler System!?
rows.notes: Miku asks whether key means system.

rows.en: Yes. As well as being a device that draws infinite power from another world...
rows.notes: System is device extracting infinite power from another world, not only key.
uncertain: As-well-as device clause continues in917.

rows.en: ...it's also a key that opens the wall between worlds. Though... it wasn't used that time.
rows.notes: Also key opens interworld wall; no use at that time.
uncertain: Completes device/key construction begun916, then complete unused-at-that-time statement.

rows.en: That time...!? D-don't tell me...!!
uncertain: Miku breaks off her startled inference.

rows.en: Was it because I... Masaki Kihara... stole Zeorymer...!?
rows.notes: Masato explicitly identifies I as Masaki Kihara and stole Zeorymer; no third-person replacement.

rows.en: Yes. You refused to entrust the key to the old men of SEELE.
rows.notes: Kaworu says listener refused to give key to SEELE elders.

rows.en: And you tried to open the door to the end with your own hands.
rows.notes: Listener wanted to open end door himself.

rows.en: Th-then, Zeorymer and Hau Dragon are...!?
uncertain: Miku leaves identification of Zeorymer/Hau Dragon purpose unfinished.

rows.en: Yes... They were built by those who knew the truth to bring this world to an end...
rows.notes: Built to end world by truth-knowers, contingent on924.
uncertain: World-ending-purpose construction continues with contingency in924.

rows.en: ...in case all of us were wiped out.
rows.notes: All of us left unexpanded; no automatic specific Angel/Mulian assignment.
uncertain: Conditional supplement follows923; all of us referent intentionally unexpanded.
All of us referent ambiguous; not expanded to named group.

rows.en: But it seems you didn't choose that option...
That's right...! I have no intention of using Zeorymer for its original purpose...
rows.notes: Rejects original purpose, not refusing use altogether.

rows.en: That's... my atonement. I will never bring this world to an end...!
rows.notes: Continuing life/action is atonement; world end explicitly rejected.

rows.en: That goes for us too!
Power and hope inherited from the past... And the seven lights...
rows.notes: Power, hope and seven lights all retained.
uncertain: Source list of inherited power/hope and seven lights has no completed predicate.

rows.en: The last hope lies within you yourself.
rows.notes: Hope within Hokuto, addressed by preceding reaction930.

rows.en: The last... hope!?
Wh-what do you know!?
You'll understand in time.
Your hearts are delicate, yet strong... That's why you deserve to claim a future.
Who will reach the far shore of time, me or you...? No, perhaps this place is already that shore.
rows.notes: Far shore may already be here; speculation retained.

rows.en: Wh-what the hell has he been talking about all this time!?
H-how should I know...!?
Now, Ollin... Soothe my heart with your song.
rows.notes: Request for listener song to soothe speaker heart; no singing offer.

rows.en: To reach Yolteotl, you must overcome this trial...
rows.notes: Trial needed to reach Yolteotl.

rows.en: Otherwise, I will be the one to tune all the worlds.
rows.notes: Otherwise conditional Kaworu tunes all worlds.

rows.en: Wh-what are you...!?
uncertain: Ayato breaks off his question.

rows.en: We bear similar destinies. ...And so does Shinji.
rows.notes: Shared destiny includes Shinji explicitly.

rows.en: A being meant to stand at the center of the world... A being that watches over countless worlds... A being at the core of eternal reincarnation...
rows.notes: World center, watching countless worlds, eternal cycle core all three retained.
uncertain: Three suspended being descriptions preserved as a list.

rows.en: The trials so far have been to decide who that will be.
I don't really understand what you're saying, Kaworu...!
That's fine for now, Shinji.
Now, Ollin... Sing. Sing your forbidden song...
rows.notes: Forbidden song request to Ollin.

rows.en: Your song that echoes from the past into the future... The song that once opened the door to the Chamber of Guf and awakened us...
rows.notes: Past-to-future song opened Chamber of Guf door and awakened us; referent unexpanded.
uncertain: Song descriptions continue request948 across row boundary.

rows.en: The song that leads the Lilin to the 'Promised Land'...!
rows.notes: Promised Land glossary stem and Lilin.
uncertain: Further song object continues request948 across row boundary.

rows.en: A god of machinery...
uncertain: Suspended identification of mechanical god retained.

rows.en: Now, sing. Sing your forbidden song.

rows.notes: Ayato's startled silence is a deliberate nonverbal utterance.

rows.en: Now... Soothe my heart with your song.
rows.notes: Again request listener song to soothe own heart, not own singing.

rows.en: A-Ayato...!!
Come. If you don't stop me here, you will perish.
Perish...? Wh-what are we supposed to do!?
We have no choice... We must defeat him.
Misato said... If an Angel makes contact with Adam, it could cause Third Impact...!
rows.notes: Vega reports Misato hypothetical Adam-contact/Third Impact; do not substitute Lilith.

rows.en: Then we can't let that happen...!
rows.notes: Answers Third Impact possibility958; prevent occurrence, not deny that possibility is true.

rows.en: D-do we have no choice but to do it...!?
rows.notes: Toji accepts need to fight; not an offer of some unrelated action.

rows.en: Yeah...! It's still far too soon for everything to end...!
...History repeats itself...
rows.notes: Private thought, history repeats; no confirmed future outcome invented.

rows.en: ...Even after thousands upon tens of thousands of cycles, the Lilin cannot escape death...
rows.notes: Cycles described in thousands/tens of thousands, Lilin death not evaded.

rows.en: But death and life are in the same place... The fate of perishing is also the joy of rebirth...
rows.notes: Life/death shared-place and destruction/rebirth paradox retained.

rows.en: As long as people don't abandon the hope within their hearts, that's enough...
rows.notes: Condition of not abandoning inner hope.

rows.en: Then, even if this world meets its end... hope will be woven into the future...
rows.notes: Hope can be passed to future despite world end, conditional continuation.

rows.en: And someday, people should be able to escape the cycle governed by Infinite Power...
rows.notes: Should be able someday is hoped future escape, not confirmation; Infinite Power fixed stem.

rows.en: ...Kaworu told me he liked me.
rows.notes: Suki rendered liked, no forced explicit love.

rows.en: For the first time... Someone told me they liked me, for the first time.
rows.notes: First someone said they liked Shinji, repetition retained.

rows.en: He was like me... and like Ayanami too. I liked him...
rows.notes: Kaworu resembles Shinji and Ayanami; Shinji liked Kaworu too.

rows.en: If one of us was going to survive, it should have been Kaworu...
rows.notes: Kaworu should have been the survivor, Shinji opinion.

rows.en: Even though he was... a much better person than me...
rows.notes: Kaworu better person than Shinji, unfinished concessive preserved.
uncertain: Source concessive ends with though/no-ni; keep dependent comparison unfinished.

rows.en: Kaworu should have survived...
...No. Only those who have the will to live survive.
rows.notes: Misato blunt subjective claim about survival and will, not universal narration.

rows.en: He wanted to die... He abandoned the will to live and clung to false hope.
rows.notes: Misato subjective judgement: wanted death, abandoned will, false hope; no softening.

rows.en: ...You didn't do anything wrong, Shinji.
rows.notes: Misato absolves Shinji.

rows.en: You're cold, Misato.
rows.notes: Shinji calls Misato cold.

rows.en: If you aren't, you won't survive... from now on.
rows.notes: Survival from now on requires coldness, Misato claim.

rows.en: Huh...? You're staying here?
Yes. We're going back to TERRA for now, to take part in that plan.
rows.notes: Temporary return to TERRA then participating in that unnamed plan; no expanded plan identity.

rows.en: I've already gotten Captain Bright's permission.
rows.notes: Captain Bright from binding character-specific naval rank.

rows.en: I see...
And... it seems Misato, Shinji and the others are staying at NERV too.
rows.notes: Misato, Shinji and others staying NERV, not all allies ordered stay.

rows.en: After what happened, that's understandable...
What are you and the others going to do, Vega?
We'll head up to space with Masato, #男愛称 and the others, and rendezvous with Nadesico C and Nahel Argama.
rows.notes: Vega group going space with Masato/protagonist to rendezvous with two ships; no ship departure order invented.

rows.en: Operation Bagration succeeded, but the fighting with Gulfer will probably continue... And I'm concerned about the Devil Gundam too.
rows.notes: Operation successful, Gulfer battle likely ongoing, Devil Gundam concern all retained.

rows.en: And the MU, too...
rows.notes: MU concern unfinished, not inserted specific threat.
uncertain: Haruka leaves the predicate about MU unfinished.

rows.en: Yes...
Well then... Have a safe trip, Vega.
rows.notes: Haruka wishes Vega safe journey, not asks for favor.

rows.en: Haruka, you and the others too...
rows.notes: Reciprocal safe-journey wish from Vega to Haruka group, not asking them to keep her safe.
uncertain: Vega leaves reciprocal safe-journey wish unfinished; source you all too retained, not a request.
